Name: (SVE) Victor Portrait
Author: KiddHusky
Description:
I love [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] created by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/46021252?tab=about+me]FlashShifter[/url]﻿, and I had some free time on my hands, so I decided to make a Victor portrait! This portrait was made to be stylized in a cartoony way, but meant to stick to the original SDV style. I hope you enjoy!

This portrait mod requires Stardew Valley Expanded!


To Install:
-Open Stardew Valley\Mods\[SVE] Victor\assets\Image
-Backup "Victor.png"
-Copy my version of the portrait into the Image folder and let it replace the original
